disease.label: STXBP1 Encephalopathy
disease.summary: A developmental and epileptic encephalopathy caused by de novo heterozygous loss-of-function variants in STXBP1, which encodes Munc18-1 (syntaxin-binding protein 1), a Sec1/Munc18 protein essential for synaptic vesicle release.
